title: Volition is the symbol of the brain state that causes the act

statements.text: Mental conditions are the symbols in consciousness of changes that take place automatically in the organism. The feeling called volition is not the cause of a voluntary act but the symbol of the brain state that is its immediate cause.

sources.quote: the feeling we call volition is not the cause of a voluntary act, but the symbol of that state of the brain which is the immediate cause of that act
